files.name: cooking_faq.md
files.summary: The document covers cooking times for rice, eggs, and bread, as well as food safety guidelines for cooked leftovers and poultry. It includes instructions on how long to cook white rice, how to prepare soft-boiled and hard-boiled eggs, and the importance of proper bread rising times. It also advises on refrigerating leftovers promptly and ensuring poultry is cooked to a safe internal temperature.
